raw.cause: While handling nav's MSG_POSITION request, gps calls MsgSend() back to nav for a MSG_HINT (gps_handle, deadlock fault). nav's only thread is REPLY-blocked in its own MsgSend() to gps, so it can never MsgReceive() the hint and gps never replies. display, already REPLY-blocked on nav, freezes behind the cycle. The gps -> nav send also violates the contract, which only allows nav -> gps.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in gps (to nav, from inside gps_handle while nav is REPLY-blocked on gps)
raw.fix_summary: Remove the gps -> nav call. gps is a leaf server and must answer MSG_POSITION from its own state. Messages should flow one way only (display -> nav -> gps), as the blueprint requires. If gps really needs route context, nav should include it in the MSG_POSITION request, or gps should get it through a non-blocking pulse. Do not add an allow rule for gps -> nav: that would legalise a send cycle.
